answer: Ration vouches as a scarce budget. Each established identity, every vertex in the trust graph, gets just three vouches per epoch to lend, and a newcomer needs five vouches from distinct vertices before it counts. Spent vouches are locked until the newcomer earns its own standing, and they burn if it turns out to be a clone. A farm can't mint trust from nothing: every fake needs five scarce vouches from real agents, who have every reason to guard them like jade. Trust enters only through a narrow, budgeted inlet that grows only as honest standing grows.
